mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive 5-day forward returns on the S&P 500, as lower interest rates reduce the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return direction is not positively correlated with FEDFUNDS (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a deepening recession, leading to negative 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 8.0 AND INDPRO < 100.0) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase (UNRATE > 8.0% and declining), rising housing starts (HOUST > HOUST_prev) signal positive 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500, as housing market strength indicates improving consumer confidence and economic activity.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8.0 AND UNRATE < UNRATE_prev AND HOUST > HOUST_prev
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 8.0, UNRATE declining, HOUST rising) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500 as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100.0) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year GDP growth rate above 2.0% signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive 60-day forward returns on the S&P 500 as investors anticipate sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances (GDPC1 growth yoy > 2.0) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and housing market activity, leading to positive 20-day forward returns on the S&P 500 as the economy moves into a sustainable expansion phase.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances (RSAFS and HOUST both rising) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 8.0% signals a recessionary condition, leading to negative 5-day forward returns on the S&P 500 as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 8.0) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
